landing.metaDesc: Meals, bazar, bills, deposits and balances for bachelor messes in Bangladesh. In Bangla and English, free, works on any phone.
landing.badge: Made for messes in Dhaka · Free
landing.subtitle: Meals, bazar, bills, deposits and everyone's balance in one app, in Bangla. No more notebook maths at the end of the month.
landing.featuresSub: Built from a real mess's monthly sheet, so the numbers match what you already do.
landing.f1d: Everyone's meals are added every day. Members turn their own off before the cutoff, with half meals and guests.
landing.f2d: Add each bazar. The meal rate updates by itself from bazar ÷ meals.
landing.f3d: Rent, gas, khala, Wi-Fi… split equally or person by person, and repeated every month.
landing.f4d: Cash, bKash or Nagad. Everyone sees what they paid, what they owe and how long their meal money lasts.
landing.f5d: The whole month like your Excel sheet, plus a report you can print or open in Excel.
landing.f6d: How many meals to cook and what, in big Bangla text. She can ask for oil or salt with one tap or a voice message.
landing.f7d: Meal cutoff, bazar duty, dues and approvals, straight to everyone's phone.
landing.f8d: Every screen in Bangla or English, with light and dark mode.
landing.s1d: Create an account and ask for a new mess. It's approved quickly.
landing.s2d: Give each member a login with a temporary password, or share the invite code.
landing.s3d: From now on the app keeps the accounts. You just check the dashboard.
landing.installSub: Works like a normal app: home-screen icon, full screen, notifications.
landing.androidHow: Open the site in Chrome → ⋮ → Install app
landing.iphoneHow: Open the site in Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen
landing.shotAlt: MessFlow dashboard: balance, today's meals and the meal money chart
landing.phoneAlt: MessFlow on a phone, in Bangla
landing.forgotPassword: Forgot your password? Tell your mess manager - they'll get it reset.
landing.footerTagline: Meals, bazar, bills and deposits for your mess, in one app.
landing.trust: Your mess's data is private: only the people of your mess can see it.
landing.h2: No more mismatched accounts at month end
landing.h3: From meals to bills, all in one place

opening.title: Opening balance (from your notebook)
opening.help: Moving from a notebook? Enter each person's old balance once. "Owes" = they owe the mess; "Is owed" = the mess owes them. It's carried into this month like last month's balance, so this month's bills and deposits stay real. Leave empty for nobody.
opening.lockNote: You can change these until you close your first month. After that they're locked into that month's bill.
